title: CVHS Dance
specs: Multiple performance opportunities including school shows and national competitions
Coaching staff consists of professional dancers and experienced choreographers
Beginning Dance open to all students, no experience needed
Show Dance requires audition and intermediate skill level
Competitive Dance requires audition and advanced skill level
Auditions require learning Jazz and Hip Hop combos; Jazz optional for All-Male dancers
Students must fill out application form and attend audition choreography days
includes: Professional coaching by experienced dancers and choreographers
Training in multiple dance styles including Hip-Hop, Jazz, Contemporary, Lyrical
Performance opportunities in school shows and competitions
blurb: The department offers Beginning Dance, Show Dance, and Competitive Dance classes for CVHS students. Students learn various dance styles and perform in school shows and competitions. Competitive Dance involves additional after-school practices and competitions including Nationals.
extraNote: No set limit on Competitive Dance team roster · Students must audition for both Show and Competitive Dance if interested
